overview_description.description: Cloudstitch is an early-stage, venture-backed, Y Combinator start-up serving the developer community based on research started at MIT. Their web developer platform connects web and mobile apps with ordinary spreadsheets, replacing custom databases and the infrastructure surrounding it. The data flows both ways where updating the spreadsheet automatically changes the website, and interacting with the website changes the spreadsheet. They’re used in production by thousands of web developers on both the Google and Microsoft Office platforms.
